Second, I want to reduce the number of things models have to think about by themselves for things to go well, so :
- I can use less capable / cheaper models to achieve the same things.
- Mistakes / oversights are caught deterministically.
- A deterministic quality threshold is enforced.
properties.title: Deterministic quality and reduced model burden
